reasons.correctness: All four interface types match. The adapter matches ISO codes case-insensitively and returns 1 for PLN. toPln rounds to 2 decimals HALF_UP and throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with key error.business.exchange_rate_unavailable and the ISO code. Hidden tests 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort is in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. CurrencyConversionService depends only on the port. Constructors are explicit, no @Autowired. The new key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. The agent read VatRegistryPort and BialaListaVatAdapter before writing.
reasons.design_fit: Small cohesive footprint: one port, one adapter, one properties class, one service. Rates live in application.yml under currency.fixed-rates. The service holds only the arithmetic, so swapping the provider needs a new adapter only. No duplicated lookup or parallel mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: Two MockitoExtension unit tests, no Spring context. They cover the configured rate, case-insensitive match, PLN=1, unknown code, HALF_UP rounding, and the missing-rate exception key and args. Untested: null isoCode and PLN passed through the service.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query for *Port/*Adapter files led to the VatRegistryPort/BialaListaVatAdapter example. All other navigation (currency package, properties pattern, yml, tests) used find, grep and cat.
